Colibri React Native Core no dependencies

Most of the catalog. Needs only React Native.

npm install @colibri-kit/native

Colibri React Native Full 4 libraries

Core plus the components that need Reanimated, Gesture Handler, SVG or Safe Area Context.

import { … } from "@colibri-kit/native/full"

Cards marked Full name the library they need; unmarked cards are Core. What is the difference? · How to install Full · API reference
